description: Eleven sheets concerning the title history of Los Luceros. Six sheets: letter from W.W. Hunker to Oliver Seth, March 11, 1959, concerning Bishop, Manuel and Hunker appraisal of Los Luceros land for Maria Chabot with three copies of "Note". Two sheets: Lyle E. Teutsch real estate listing for Los Luceros, Mar. 14, 1959, 2 copies. Four sheets: P.F. McCanna Co. real estate listing for Los Luceros, Nov. 4, 1959 and Nov 5, 1959 [2 copies]. Two sheets: real estate listing, signed by MC, June 1960 [The form is the same as the P.F. McCanna forms but is not headed.] Two sheets: two traced maps of Los Luceros land found without context, undated.
title: Deeds, appraisals, real estate, maps
